explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/540 (Erdős–Heilbronn): is it true that if A ⊆ ℤ/Nℤ has size ≫ N^{1/2} then some non-empty S ⊆ A has Σ_{n∈S} n ≡ 0 (mod N)? Yes (Olson for prime N, Szemerédi in general). The Lean statement: ∃ C > 0, ∀ N > 0, ∀ A : Finset (ZMod N) with C·√N ≤ |A|, A has a non-empty subset with sum 0. This is the correct unpacking of '≫ N^{1/2}' (a sufficiently large absolute constant). Faithful.
